verses.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος οὐκ ἀπ’ ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Paulos apostolos ouk ap’ anthrōpōn oude di’ anthrōpou alla dia Iēsou Christou kai Theou Patros tou egeirantos auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: Paul an apostle sent not from men nor by man but by Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised Him from the dead

verses.original: καὶ οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ πάντες ἀδελφοί Ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας
verses.transliteration: kai hoi syn emoi pantes adelphoi Tais ekklēsiais tēs Galatias
verses.literal: and all the brothers with me To the churches of Galatia

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: τοῦ δόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ὅπως ἐξέληται ἡμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος πονηροῦ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: tou dontos heauton hyper tōn hamartiōn hēmōn hopōs exelētai hēmas ek tou aiōnos tou enestōtos ponērou kata to thelēma tou Theou kai Patros hēmōn
verses.literal: who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age according to the will of our God and Father

verses.original: ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: to whom be glory forever and ever Amen

verses.original: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως ταχέως μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον
verses.transliteration: Thaumazō hoti houtōs tacheōs metatithesthe apo tou kalesantos hymas en chariti Christou eis heteron euangelion
verses.literal: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel

verses.original: ὃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλο εἰ μή τινές εἰσιν οἱ ταράσσοντες ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλοντες μεταστρέψαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho ouk estin allo ei mē tines eisin hoi tarassontes hymas kai thelontes metastrepsai to euangelion tou Christou
verses.literal: which is not even a gospel Evidently . . . some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐὰν ἡμεῖς ἢ ἄγγελος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εὐαγγελίζηται ὑμῖν παρ’ ὃ εὐηγγελισάμεθα ὑμῖν ἀνάθεμα ἔστω
verses.transliteration: Alla kai ean hēmeis ē angelos ex ouranou euangelizētai hymin par’ ho euēngelisametha hymin anathema estō
verses.literal: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel . . . contrary to the one we preached to you let him be under a curse

verses.original: ὡς προειρήκαμεν καὶ ἄρτι πάλιν λέγω εἴ τις ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελίζεται παρ’ ὃ παρελάβετε ἀνάθεμα ἔστω
verses.transliteration: hōs proeirēkamen kai arti palin legō ei tis hymas euangelizetai par’ ho parelabete anathema estō
verses.literal: As we have said before so now I say again If anyone is preaching to you a gospel . . . contrary to the one you received let him be under a curse

verses.original: Ἄρτι γὰρ ἀνθρώπους πείθω ἢ τὸν Θεόν ἢ ζητῶ ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκειν εἰ ἔτι ἀνθρώποις ἤρεσκον Χριστοῦ δοῦλος οὐκ ἂν ἤμην
verses.transliteration: Arti gar anthrōpous peithō ē ton Theon ē zētō anthrōpois areskein ei eti anthrōpois ēreskon Christou doulos ouk an ēmēn
verses.literal: Am I now seeking the approval of men or of God Or am I striving to please men If I were still trying to please . . . men I would not be a servant of Christ

verses.original: γνωρίζω γὰρ ὑμῖν ἀδελφοί τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπ’ ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: gnōrizō gar hymin adelphoi to euangelion to euangelisthen hyp’ emou hoti ouk estin kata anthrōpon
verses.literal: For I want you to know . . . brothers that the gospel I preached . . . . . . was not devised by man

verses.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐγὼ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου παρέλαβον αὐτό οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην ἀλλὰ δι’ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: oude gar egō para anthrōpou parelabon auto oute edidachthēn alla di’ apokalypseōs Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: I did not receive it from any man nor was I taught it rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε γὰρ τὴν ἐμὴν ἀναστροφήν ποτε ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὅτι καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate gar tēn emēn anastrophēn pote en tō Ioudaismō hoti kath’ hyperbolēn ediōkon tēn ekklēsian tou Theou kai eporthoun autēn
verses.literal: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism how severely . . . I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it

verses.original: καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων
verses.transliteration: kai proekopton en tō Ioudaismō hyper pollous synēlikiōtas en tō genei mou perissoterōs zēlōtēs hyparchōn tōn patrikōn mou paradoseōn
verses.literal: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries . . . . . . . . . . . . and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers

verses.original: Ὅτε δὲ εὐδόκησεν ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἀφορίσας με ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου καὶ καλέσας διὰ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hote de eudokēsen ho theos ho aphorisas me ek koilias mētros mou kai kalesas dia tēs charitos autou
verses.literal: But when God who set me apart . . . from my mother’s womb and called me by His grace was pleased

verses.original: ἀποκαλύψαι τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἵνα εὐαγγελίζωμαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐθέως οὐ προσανεθέμην σαρκὶ καὶ αἵματι
verses.transliteration: apokalypsai ton Huion autou en emoi hina euangelizōmai auton en tois ethnesin eutheōs ou prosanethemēn sarki kai haimati
verses.literal: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles I did not rush to consult . . . . . . with flesh and blood

verses.original: οὐδὲ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα πρὸς τοὺς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἀποστόλους ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθον εἰς Ἀραβίαν καὶ πάλιν ὑπέστρεψα εἰς Δαμασκόν
verses.transliteration: oude anēlthon eis Hierosolyma pros tous pro emou apostolous alla apēlthon eis Arabian kai palin hypestrepsa eis Damaskon
verses.literal: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before me but I went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus

verses.original: Ἔπειτα μετὰ τρία ἔτη ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι Κηφᾶν καὶ ἐπέμεινα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡμέρας δεκαπέντε
verses.transliteration: Epeita meta tria etē anēlthon eis Hierosolyma historēsai Kēphan kai epemeina pros auton hēmeras dekapente
verses.literal: Only after . . . three years did I go up to Jerusalem to confer with Cephas and I stayed with him fifteen days

verses.original: ἕτερον δὲ τῶν ἀποστόλων οὐκ εἶδον εἰ μὴ Ἰάκωβον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: heteron de tōn apostolōn ouk eidon ei mē Iakōbon ton adelphon tou Kyriou
verses.literal: But I saw none of the other apostles except . . . James the Lord’s brother

verses.original: ἃ δὲ γράφω ὑμῖν ἰδοὺ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι
verses.transliteration: ha de graphō hymin idou enōpion tou Theou hoti ou pseudomai
verses.literal: I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie

verses.original: Ἔπειτα ἦλθον εἰς τὰ κλίματα τῆς Συρίας καὶ τῆς Κιλικίας
verses.transliteration: Epeita ēlthon eis ta klimata tēs Syrias kai tēs Kilikias
verses.literal: Later I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia

verses.original: ἤμην δὲ ἀγνοούμενος τῷ προσώπῳ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Ἰουδαίας ταῖς ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: ēmēn de agnooumenos tō prosōpō tais ekklēsiais tēs Ioudaias tais en Christō
verses.literal: I was personally unknown however to the churches of Judea that are in Christ

verses.original: μόνον δὲ ἀκούοντες ἦσαν ὅτι Ὁ διώκων ἡμᾶς ποτε νῦν εὐαγγελίζεται τὴν πίστιν ἥν ποτε ἐπόρθει
verses.transliteration: monon de akouontes ēsan hoti Ho diōkōn hēmas pote nyn euangelizetai tēn pistin hēn pote eporthei
verses.literal: They only heard the account The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy

verses.original: καὶ ἐδόξαζον ἐν ἐμοὶ τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: kai edoxazon en emoi ton Theon
verses.literal: And they glorified God because of me
